description:
##50% is due at the time of booking. The remaining balance is due at the time of the charter.

##Departing Location

Boston Sailing Tours departure location is at Courthouse Docks, Located Across From Marcelino's Seaport - 2 Northern Ave, Boston, MA 02210. All trips will depart from this location. Paid public parking is available.
[MAP] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/gHTdWAB4SDhYSsPQ6)

##Duration

4 Hours

##About

A Sailors Experience: We will sail on the picturesque old sailing route around the major islands. You will get to see up close the stone fortresses, and the spectacular coastline so typical of New England. You can also take the helm and discover how to sail our traditional cutter ketch ( 2 masts and 4 sails).

##What to Bring

CONSIDER TO BRING
Sailors should dress for safety, comfort, and weather. In spring and fall, dress in layers and bring a jacket or sweatshirt; it can be cooler at sea than on land.

In summer, bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen. 

For safety and comfort, soft-soled shoes like boat shoes or sneakers are the preferred footwear aboard the Francesca. You will be asked to go barefoot for safety reasons if you wear hard-soled shoes or high heels on board.

##What Not To Bring
'Per Federal regulation no marijuana or marijuana-containing products no illicit drugs

##Food, Drinks, Music

• You’re welcome to bring your favorite food, drinks, and music.
• We recommend easy-to-eat items and canned drinks. 
• We do not have a formal table in the cockpit
• We have complimentary water and sodas on board
